services.name: Programs
services.desc: The Winter and Summer Sapling programs are 3-6 months long, immersive, apprenticeship-type programs for experienced sailors looking to get a hand up in the sailing industry, or want to try all different sailing disciplines before deciding their focus. Spend a whole summer, winter or year at Oakcliff. You will get to learn all there is to know about racing, boat maintenance, organization and more from the experts at Oakcliff. Have a gap year, or time off in the winter? Oakcliff sailing does not stop when the snow flies. services.name: Custom Coaching and Charters
services.desc: If you are interested in sailing at Oakcliff, but do not have the time for a full-time training program, consider these options. We offer specialized, custom training in our high performance boats - including Nacra 17s and 49ers - at the beginning of the summer. You can sign up for custom coaching through our Acorn program application. You can also charter our Nacras and 49ers for regattas, including our Triple Crown Series each fall, or the ODP camps and OCR Regattas in Miami each winter. Find out more about our 49er Charter here and our foiling Nacra 17 charter here. services.desc: Get personalized coaching from one of our experienced high-performance coaches in a private or group setting.
